title: Story Circle
summary: Dan Harmon's eight-step circular structure for tracking desire, threshold-crossing, adaptation, cost, return, and change.

beats.label: You
beats.summary: The protagonist in a zone of comfort. Establishes identity, routine, and the pre-change self.

beats.label: Need
beats.summary: The protagonist wants something, lacks something, or feels a pressure that starts the story engine.

beats.label: Go
beats.summary: The protagonist crosses a threshold into an unfamiliar situation and can no longer solve things the old way.

beats.label: Search
beats.summary: The protagonist adapts, tests tactics, meets resistance, and learns the rules of the new world.

beats.label: Find
beats.summary: The protagonist gets what they were chasing or sees the real nature of the prize; the story pivots.

beats.label: Take
beats.summary: The prize has a cost. The protagonist loses, sacrifices, or discovers that winning changes the terms.

beats.label: Return
beats.summary: The protagonist turns back toward home or the original problem carrying what they found.

beats.label: Return Changed
beats.summary: The protagonist integrates the lesson in a final test, proving visible change before the story closes.
